description_en: Queries the top N client fingerprints for a website
description_zh: 查询网站Top N 客户端指纹
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-top-fingerprint --biz-region cn --domain example.aliyundoc.com --start-time 1719211800 --end-time 1723552200 --limit 10 --interval 60 --query-type example-string --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainTopFingerprint

parameters.help_en:
The region of the service. Valid values:
cn: the Chinese mainland.
cn-hongkong: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
服务地域。取值：
cn：中国内地。
cn-hongkong：非中国内地
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.
The domain name must have a website traffic forwarding rule configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the exact minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the exact minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of data entries to return
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The step size for returned data. Unit: seconds. This specifies the interval between consecutive results
parameters.help_zh: 返回数据的步长，单位为秒，即每隔多少秒返回一个结果
parameters.name: interval
